verdict: Leads and cost per lead are moving in the right direction this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 139 leads at an average cost of $15.16 per lead across Meta. This past week leads rose nearly 15% and cost per lead dropped 10% compared to the prior week — a meaningful improvement after a soft stretch. One day late in the period (November 7) produced only a single lead, but that coincides with a consistent Sunday low-spend pattern and is not, on its own, a signal of creative fatigue. Ad spend and targeting are being reviewed this week to protect the improving efficiency trend heading into the next period.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply week-over-week, with the last several days showing near-zero activity — it is unclear whether organic discovery has softened or whether there is a reporting gap.
watch_item.fix: Profile data is being audited this week to confirm whether this reflects real traffic loss or a tracking issue, and next steps will follow from that.
